title: West Ham look to boost midfield with bid for Monaco’s Soungoutou Magassa
trail: West Ham have submitted a bid for Monaco’s Soungoutou Magassa and are pushing to complete a deal for the France Under-21s midfielder
body: West Ham have submitted a bid for Monaco’s Soungoutou Magassa and are pushing to complete a deal for the Monaco midfielder. Graham Potter is looking to make two additions in midfield and is moving ahead with his plans after an agreement was reached for Edson Álvarez to join Fenerbahce on loan. Talks are taking place between West Ham and the Turkish club regarding the final details of a deal for the Mexico international. Targeting the 21-year-old Magassa is a sign of West Ham’s desire to add youth and energy to their squad. He made 29 appearances in all competitions for Monaco last season, playing in the Champions League, and represented France Under-21s at this summer’s European Championship. West Ham see Magassa as a filling a slot in defensive midfield. They want to add more power and need someone to set the tempo and control play from deep positions. Potter is also targeting a No 8 and has tried to sign Southampton’s Mateus Fernandes. West Ham are also monitoring Rennes’ Djaoui Cissé, Werder Bremen’s Romano Schmid, Feyernoord’s Quinten Timber, Ajax’s Kenneth Taylor and Torino’s Ivan Ilic. The Lens midfielder Andy Diouf is expected to join Inter. Besiktas have tabled an offer for the Italy left-back Emerson Palmieri, who is surplus to requirements following the signing of El Hadji Malick Diouf.
